```{r}
texas_WRA <- ms_simplify(texas_WRA, keep = 0.05, keep_shapes = TRUE)




# Function to generate smooth points along linestring
get_points_along <- function(route, n_points = 100){
  coords <- st_coordinates(route)
  dist <- cumsum(c(0, sqrt(diff(coords[,1])^2 + diff(coords[,2])^2)))
  dist <- dist / max(dist)
  
  new_dist <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_points)
  new_x <- approx(dist, coords[,1], xout = new_dist)$y
  new_y <- approx(dist, coords[,2], xout = new_dist)$y
  
  data.frame(lon = new_x, lat = new_y)
}

points_df <- get_points_along(texas_roads_stfp[1, ])
```

```{r}
# Add van animation via onRender
points_df <- get_points_along(texas_roads_stfp[1, ], n_points=200)
js_points <- paste0("[", paste(apply(points_df, 1, function(r) paste0("[", r['lat'], ",", r['lon'], "]")), collapse=","), "]")
van_url <- "https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTRXrGrn09EPK0AQc_-SSS6bYNkL57kve7b5A&s"

m <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m, sprintf("
function(el,x){
  var map = this;
  var vanIcon = L.icon({iconUrl: '%s', iconSize: [32,32], iconAnchor: [16,16]});
  var marker = L.marker([%f,%f], {icon: vanIcon}).addTo(map);
  var points = %s;
  var i=0;
  function moveMarker(){ if(i>=points.length) return; marker.setLatLng(points[i]); i++; setTimeout(moveMarker,50);}
  moveMarker();
}
", van_url, points_df$lat[1], points_df$lon[1], js_points))



m <-  htmlwidgets::onRender(m, "
    function(el, x) {
      var legend = el.querySelector('.leaflet-control .leaflet-control-legend');

        legend.style.marginLeft = '40px';  // Increase to push it out more

# force map to resize correctly when DOM settles

m <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m, "
function(el,x){
  var map=this;
  // expose for external scripts
  window.txMap = map;

  // existing resize kick
  function kick(){ try{ map.invalidateSize(); }catch(e){} }
  map.whenReady(function(){
    kick(); setTimeout(kick,0); setTimeout(kick,250); setTimeout(kick,600);
  });
}
")
```

```{=html}

<script>
(function () {
  const norm = s => (s || '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();

  function overlaysReady(){
    return document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays label').length > 0;
  }
  function stepsReady(){
    return document.querySelectorAll('.cr-step[data-group]').length > 0;
  }
  function getOverlayMap(){
    const map = new Map();
    document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers-overlays label')
      .forEach(lbl => {
        const name = norm(lbl.textContent);
        const box  = lbl.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (name && box) map.set(name, box);
      });
    return map;
  }
  function tick(group, overlayMap){
    if (!group) return false;
    const want = norm(group);
    let box = overlayMap.get(want);
    if (!box) {
      // case-insensitive fallback
      const gl = want.toLowerCase();
      for (const [k,b] of overlayMap.entries()) if (k.toLowerCase() === gl) { box = b; break; }
    }
    if (box) { if (!box.checked) box.click(); return true; }
    return false;
  }

  function wire(){
    const steps = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cr-step[data-group]'));
    const overlayMap = getOverlayMap();
    if (!steps.length || !overlayMap.size) return false;

    let last = -1;
    function revealUpTo(i){
      if (i <= last) return;
      for (let k = last + 1; k <= i; k++){
        tick(steps[k].dataset.group, overlayMap);
      }
      last = Math.max(last, i);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
    }

    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        const idx = steps.indexOf(entry.target);
        steps.forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('is-active', i===idx));
        revealUpTo(idx);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.30, rootMargin: '-28% 0% -34% 0%' });

    steps.forEach(s => io.observe(s));

    setTimeout(() => {
      const bandTop = innerHeight * 0.28, bandBot = innerHeight * 0.66;
      let idx = -1;
      for (let i=0;i<steps.length;i++){
        const r = steps[i].getBoundingClientRect();
        const c = (r.top + r.bottom)/2;
        if (c >= bandTop && c <= bandBot) { idx = i; break; }
        if (r.top <= bandBot) idx = i;
      }
      if (idx >= 0) revealUpTo(idx);
    }, 0);

    window._layersList = () => Array.from(overlayMap.keys());
    window._revealAll  = () => revealUpTo(steps.length - 1);

    return true;
  }

  function tryWire(){
    if (overlaysReady() && stepsReady()) return wire();
    return false;
  }

  if (!tryWire()){
    const mo = new MutationObserver(() => { if (tryWire()) mo.disconnect(); });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList:true, subtree:true });
  }
})();
</script>


<script>
(function(){
  const parseBBox = (s) => {
    if (!s) return null;
    const a = s.split(',').map(Number);
    if (a.length !== 4 || a.some(v => isNaN(v))) return null;
    // Leaflet expects [[S,W],[N,E]]
    return [[a[1], a[0]], [a[3], a[2]]];
  };

  function getMap(){
    return window.txMap || null;
  }

  function zoomForStep(map, el){
    if (!map || !el) return;

    // Allow one-time behavior with data-zoom-once="true"
    if (el.dataset.zoomOnce === 'true' && el._didZoom) return;

    const bbox = parseBBox(el.dataset.bbox);
    if (bbox){
      map.fitBounds(bbox, {
        paddingTopLeft:    [20, 90],  // leave room for your fixed title
        paddingBottomRight:[20, 20],
        animate: true
      });
      el._didZoom = true;
      return;
    }

    const lat = parseFloat(el.dataset.lat);
    const lng = parseFloat(el.dataset.lng);
    const zm  = parseFloat(el.dataset.zoom || '8');

    if (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)){
      map.flyTo([lat, lng], isNaN(zm) ? map.getZoom() : zm, {
        animate: true,
        duration: 1.0,    // seconds
        easeLinearity: 0.25
      });
      el._didZoom = true;
    }
  }

  function wire(){
    const map = getMap();
    const steps = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#cr-steps .cr-step, #cr-steps .cr-step-wide'));
    if (!map || !steps.length) return false;

    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        // When a step becomes active in the band, zoom to it
        zoomForStep(map, entry.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.30, rootMargin: '-28% 0% -34% 0%' });

    steps.forEach(s => io.observe(s));

    // Optional: on load, zoom to the first step that's already centered
    setTimeout(() => {
      const vhTop = innerHeight * 0.28, vhBot = innerHeight * 0.66;
      for (const s of steps){
        const r = s.getBoundingClientRect();
        const c = (r.top + r.bottom)/2;
        if (c >= vhTop && c <= vhBot){ zoomForStep(map, s); break; }
      }
    }, 0);

    return true;
  }

  // Wait for map to be ready (onRender sets window.txMap)
  if (!wire()){
    const mo = new MutationObserver(() => { if (wire()) mo.disconnect(); });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList:true, subtree:true });
  }
})();
</script>
```

```{r}
library(htmlwidgets)
library(leaflet)

# Existing map: `m` (you already have it)
# Generate points along your route
points_df <- get_points_along(texas_roads_stfp[1, ], n_points = 200)

# Convert points to JS array
js_points <- paste0("[", paste(apply(points_df, 1, function(r) paste0("[", r['lat'], ",", r['lon'], "]")), collapse = ","), "]")

van_url <- "https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTRXrGrn09EPK0AQc_-SSS6bYNkL57kve7b5A&s"

# Inject JS animation
m <- htmlwidgets::onRender(m, sprintf("
function(el,x){
  var map = this;

  var vanIcon = L.icon({
    iconUrl: '%s',
    iconSize: [32, 32],
    iconAnchor: [16, 16]
  });

  var marker = L.marker([%f, %f], {icon: vanIcon}).addTo(map);

  var points = %s;
  var i = 0;

  function moveMarker() {
    if(i >= points.length) return;
    marker.setLatLng(points[i]);
    i++;
    setTimeout(moveMarker, 50);  // adjust speed
  }

  moveMarker();
}
", van_url, points_df$lat[1], points_df$lon[1], js_points))
```
